name: plexmediaserver

check.cmd: snap info plexmediaserver | grep installed > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: hash snap > /dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt update && sudo apt install snapd -y

description.zh: Plex Media Server: 用于组织视频、图片及音频文件。
description.en: Plex Media Server is a software application that allows you to organize and stream your collection of videos, music, and photos.
